title: Weird gets posted on weekends
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Weird-word stories make up a bigger share of weekend submissions than of all submissions.
expect: The topic share of UTC weekend stories divided by its share of all stories, across 2006 to 2026: at least 1.1x supports (1.3x or more is strong); at or below 0.9x refutes. Between is inconclusive. Title matching only.

group_a.label: weird and mysterious words share of weekend stories ({from} to {to})

group_b.label: weird and mysterious words share of all stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Exploratory. Thresholds copied from the card this one replaces.
caveats: Title matching only: the word list is in scripts/film.py and will miss and mis-match some stories.
Archive scores and comment counts for recent stories are low for all stories, so only ratios against the same months are used.
Associations do not show what causes attention.
